text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Summer was over. We had all the fun we 
could at the training camp, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo and Nice Nature. It was a 
summer where both gave it their all in 
their respective eastern and western local 
races.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo got crazy strong in Fukushima! 
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, your running has improved 
drastically, too.

Yeah, your running style has evolved 
tremendously too.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, Trainer gave me tons of praise, you 
know. How about you, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
For me too... I guess it really felt like 
a summer of pure growth. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature finally captures a graded race 
victory! That makes three straight wins!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the upcoming autumn, she might just 
become one of the main contenders in the 
final leg of the Triple Crown, the 
Kikuka-sho!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeehk, did I win a Graded race!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Did you forget, Turbo-brain?! Even Ikuno 
was in that race?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Twin Turbo wasn't the only one having 
smooth sailing. Nice Nature had also 
safely cleared the checkpoint."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...We both did what we had to do. I'm not 
the same person who lost so terribly to 
Teio at New Year's anymore."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
When autumn comes, we gotta give it our 
all, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo wants to burn completely out 
even more in front of everyone. I'll show 
you how hot I can burn!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer, Nature! Teio's 
definitely coming too. So let's all do it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Progress varies for everyone. Yet time 
flows equally and mercilessly. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stars of our generation, once 
scattered far and wide, assemble once 
again this autumn at the grand racecourse.
